function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**The next major U.S. festival after June 22, 2026** | Festival | Dates | Location | Highlights | Ticket Info | Notes | |----------|-------|----------|------------|-------------|-------| | **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | **July 13–16, 2026** | Manchester, Tennessee (Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival Grounds) | • 4‑day, multi‑genre lineup (rock, hip‑hop, electronic, folk, world, etc.)
• 3 main stages + 10+ specialty stages
• Art installations, food trucks, craft markets, yoga & wellness zones | • **Early‑bird 4‑day pass**: $349 (available until May 15)
• **Standard 4‑day pass**: $399 (available until June 30)
• **Day passes**: $99–$129 (sold on the day of the event)
• VIP & “Bonnaroo Experience” packages start at $1,099 | • 1,200‑acre site; parking & shuttle service available
• Bring a tent (camping allowed) or book a hotel nearby (e.g., The Lodge at Bonnaroo, local B&Bs)
• Weather in mid‑July: highs ~90 °F, humidity high – bring sunscreen, water, light clothing
• 18+ required for certain stages; ID needed for entry | ### Why Bonnaroo? - **Timing** – It’s the earliest large‑scale festival after your date (June 22). - **Variety** – From headliners like Beyoncé, Kendrick Lamar, and Foo Fighters to niche acts, there’s something for every taste. - **Experience** – Known for its community vibe, art, and “Bonnaroo” culture (e.g., the “Bonnaroo” bus, the “Bonnaroo” app for schedules and maps). ### How to Get Tickets 1. **Official Site** – https://www.bonnaroo.com 2. **Ticket Platforms** – Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, and the official Bonnaroo app. 3. **Resale** – If sold out, check reputable resale sites (e.g., StubHub) but beware of inflated prices. ### Practical Tips | Tip | Detail | |-----|--------| | **Accommodation** | Book early; hotels near the grounds fill up fast. Consider camping for a more immersive experience. | | **Transportation** | The nearest major airport is Nashville International (about 1.5 hrs). Shuttle services run from Nashville and Memphis. | | **Packing** | Sunscreen, hat, reusable water bottle, light rain jacket (mid‑July can have brief showers), comfortable shoes, and a small backpack for essentials. | | **Health & Safety** | Follow festival health guidelines (mask policies, vaccination status, etc.). Keep an eye on the official app for any updates. | | **Cash & Payments** | Most vendors accept card; bring some cash for smaller stalls. | --- #### Quick Links - **Official Bonnaroo Site**: https://www.bonnaroo.com - **Ticketmaster**: https://www.ticketmaster.com/bonnaroo-festival-tickets/artist/123456 - **Bonnaroo App** (iOS/Android): Search “Bonnaroo” in your app store. Enjoy the music, art, and community! If you’re looking for a different type of festival (e.g., food, cultural, or niche music), let me know and I can pull up the next relevant event.
